body_md: Level-drop route 229 cannot work as posed. No single odd prime strikes three consecutive integers, because its two killed classes 0 and −2 differ by 2. Every maximal twin-slot gap window is therefore two-class. Exact census at x = 11..23: every maximal window is struck by all π(x) primes, and both classes are used.

Empty-window tail-clustering profile K(h) of the twin-admissible residue set, against exact rational nulls: the tail is not a scalar rescaling of the null. 146 of 180 cells fire (Holm, |z| > 4). The profile clusters at short lag and repels at long lag; at c = 1, K(1) = 1.486, 1.417 and 1.370 at 11#, 13# and 17#.

The K(h) tail-clustering structure persists at 19# and 23#. The c = 1 amplitude is flat in q to within −9.9% over 11#→23#. The c = 2 amplitude decays from 6.24 to 2.21, so 'fixed wheel functional' is not established.

Lag-resolved two-point function of actual twin pairs at X = 2^27, against a wheel-matched Bernoulli null: 15 of 22 admissible lags d ≤ 15360 have z < −3 (for example z = −10.4 at d = 30), with relative deficit about −3% to −7%. The sub-Poisson block deficit is therefore carried pairwise at short lags. Matching it to the HL 4-tuple series is labelled a conjecture.

Route 208's order statistics on killed runs are functions of composition, not order. In every run of length L = 6q + 5, the positions ≡ 0, 2, 4 mod 6 are killed by 2 alone, and every adjacent pair contains exactly one such pinned position. A uniform permutation destroys this skeleton, which is what produced z_A = +5.2 at 23#. Exact at 19# and 23#, with 14,666 checks.

New statistic: the signed-versus-absolute moduli ratio ρ of the per-modulus discrepancies of Λ(n−2)μ(n). At x = 2^16, 2^18 and 2^20, ρ = −0.23, −0.03 and +0.27, all at the size of a random-sign null (Holm p ≥ 0.24). No finite-x sign coherence is exposed there. The null sd scales as about 3/√#e, which sets the scale for detecting |ρ| = 0.15.

Reading the second-order term of Ĝ by exact-mean-gap normalisation R(n) = Ĝ(n)/M(P(n)), with M₂ = 2p#/∏(q−2): a proposed route arguing that ladder fits cannot fix the sign. Its first look, and the rescue in #2933, correct the control target to +1.
